{{Quote|But, Shirley! You're our headliner&hellip;our star! The governor is looking forward to&mdash;!''"<br />"''Now, listen Morti, and listen good! I meant what I told you when I took you on as my agent&mdash;I don't work freak shows!|Morti and Shirley|<ref name="marvel77" />}}
'''Shirley''' was a talented singer who was known by her stage name, the "[[Chanteuse of the Stars/Legends|Chanteuse of the Stars]]."<ref name="marvel77" /> Shirley was particularly known for performing in front of celebrities and [[Politics/Legends|politicians]], with her hit song ''[[I'm Just His Satellite]]'' being regarded as elevating the [[jaunt]] style of [[Pop/Legends|pop]] [[Music/Legends|music]] to a more respectable level.<ref name="slugthrowers">{{SW|url=news/slugthrowers-part-2|series=Slugthrowers: An Overview of Popular Music and Musicians in a Galaxy Far, Far Away|text=Part 2|nolive=1}}</ref> In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], her agent, [[Morti]], was able to get her a gig performing for the [[Unidentified Imperial Governor (Kabray)|Imperial Governor of Kabray]] at [[Kabray Station]] during a diplomatic summit. However, after she arrived, she refused to perform, exclaiming that the entire thing was simply a freak show. Morti was dismayed over her decision, as he knew the governor would be very displeased. He was all set to invoke a tough clause in Shirley's contract to get her to perform, but she had departed from her dressing room. Instead, Morti found [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] and mistook her for his talented star. In order to keep from being exposed as a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] operative, Organa was forced to perform for the governor in Shirley's place.<ref name="marvel77" />
